description: Scans a domain live on thirteen public signals (HTTPS, HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, DNSSEC, SPF, DMARC, CAA, security.txt, llms.txt, AI-crawler policy and more) and returns a score out of 100, a grade, and each failing check with the exact fix. Free, no account. The score reads public signals only; it says nothing about who runs the domain.
name: lunara_passport_scan
title: Scan a domain's security passport
